fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Ember learns when you are home and heats only the rooms you use, so most homes save a fifth on heating in the first winter.

default.alt: The round Ember thermostat on a living room wall

itemFields.name: text
itemFields.label: Text
itemFields.default: Describe the benefit in one or two sentences.

default.title: Learns your week
default.text: After seven days it knows when to warm up before you wake and wind down when you leave.

default.title: Knows when you are out
default.text: Your phone tells Ember when the last person leaves, so the heating never runs for an empty house.

default.title: Room by room
default.text: Pair radiator valves to heat the office at nine and the bedrooms at ten.

itemFields.name: text
itemFields.label: Text
itemFields.default: Describe the benefit in one or two sentences.

default.title: A monthly energy report
default.text: See what each room cost and where a degree lower would save the most.

default.title: One app for the house
default.text: Everyone in the household can adjust their own rooms without fighting over the dial.

default.title: Works offline
default.text: If the internet drops, your schedule keeps running from the device itself.
